## Purpose and scope
What behavior changes, and what is intentionally unchanged?

## Evidence
- [ ] Exact commands, platform and results documented
- [ ] `npm run test:all` and `npm run smoke` pass, or blockers explained
- [ ] Screenshots and visual baseline notes for UI changes
- [ ] Security-sensitive inputs, guard failures and rollback tested where relevant
- [ ] No private data, API keys, credentials or customer identifiers included

## Risk and rollback
What can fail? How can the previous version be restored?

## Release impact
Preview/stable behavior changes, compatibility, and documentation updates.
